issues.summary: accessible={false} on the backdrop takes tap-outside-to-dismiss away from screen readers
issues.label: low
issues.evidence: DialogModal.tsx:32 does set accessible={false} on the overlay. Before this, though, the accessible overlay grouped the whole dialog into one element, so screen-reader users never had tap-outside as a separate action. The Cancel button (line 57) still dismisses the dialog, so the cost is small.

issues.label: low
issues.evidence: DialogModal.tsx:57 and :63 have no accessibilityRole. These lines existed before the PR, but the PR makes them individually reachable by screen readers for the first time, so they are now read out without a button role. Real but minor accessibility polish.

issues.summary: No test locks in the accessible={false} fix for DialogModal and its consumers
issues.label: low
issues.evidence: The diff only changes DialogModal.tsx:32 and :42 and adds no tests. No test file references DialogModal, CustomNonceModal or AddToAddressBookModal. If someone reverted the fix, only screen-reader users would be affected and CI would not notice, but the impact is limited to accessibility.
